com.dustinky.qwenpaw.desc:
QwenPaw 是一款个人助理型产品（国产小龙虾），部署在你自己的环境中。

核心功能

多通道对话（微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书、Discord、Telegram 等），多智能体协作（独立配置、记忆和技能，互相通信完成复杂任务），定时执行任务，能力由 Skills 决定且可无限扩展，支持本地运行大模型完全离线工作，数据全在本地不依赖第三方托管，多层安全防护机制。使用 Ollama 需先在飞牛应用商店安装 Ollama 应用，连接时 API Key 不可为空。更多问题可加入 QQ 群 1091348192 进行交流。
com.dustinky.qwenpaw.author: AgentScope团队

dpanel.desc:
DPanel 是一款轻量化的管理 Docker、Podman 容器的可视化面板。👉👉👉 更多功能介绍

交流群

界面预览
dpanel.author: DPanel-dev

1.11.3.changelog:
feat: toggle panel features and shortcuts; menus and actions respect feature dependencies and user permissions
feat: guide the panel owner through the main features and let them replay the tour from system settings
feat: read release notes before a panel upgrade and expand the execution log while it runs
feat: sort the container list by status, including health checks, to find unhealthy or restarting containers (#336)
feat: quickly create an empty file or directory from the file manager context menu, or jump to a directory with path suggestions
feat: rename files while editing without overwriting existing files; enter numeric UID and GID values when changing ownership
feat: connect TCP/TLS and SSH Docker environments, host terminals, and SSH file access through an SSH jump host (#255)
feat: browse and sync the System Plugins catalog; the plugin and 1Panel store pages flag available source updates

1.11.2.changelog:
feat: choose between saving Compose changes only and saving then deploying, with execution logs available during deployment
feat: configure App Store applications in the Compose editor before installation, including task names, YAML, and environment variables, with Save Only and Save
feat: restore the previous YAML files, `.env`, and task settings if directory synchronization or deployment fails during Save and Deploy while its matching back
feat: bring external Compose tasks with inaccessible YAML files under panel management by supplying their YAML and environment variables, without changing the o
feat: identify Compose tasks whose main YAML file is missing or empty and provide an entry to complete their configuration
feat: show the host-side Compose task directory when creating tasks and clarify when mounted-directory creation is unavailable
feat: update images directly from the image list or details, choose the upstream source when multiple sources exist, migrate ordinary tags to the new image, and
feat: attempt to remove the previous image after a manual container upgrade when it is no longer in use
